meta.description: Explains ML predictions on omics data with SHAP, LIME, and permutation importance, handling correlated features, explicit TreeSHAP estimands, and the attribution-is-not-causation boundary.
meta.note: Re-audit targets every P1/P2 in the 2026-09-16 audit and executes both shipped examples from the exact commit.

scientific_integrity.detail: The false tree_path_dependent unused-feature claim was removed. The exact-commit depth-1 probe gives B and C exactly zero under both modes, while the depth-2 probe confirms the narrower, documented mode-dependent split for A/B.

practice_boundaries.detail: The attribution-is-not-biology, not-causation, and not-biomarker boundaries remain explicit.

methodological_ground.detail: Module construction now declares Spearman correlation, average linkage, a starting cut, and sensitivity reporting. Background and LIME sections require rank-overlap measurement instead of universal instability claims.

code_usability.detail: Both shipped examples ran under shap 0.52.0/lime 0.2.0.1; the new module-map block executes on pandas 3.0.5 after an explicit writable array copy.

functional_suitability.note: All method-family guidance is now aligned with executable TreeSHAP behavior.

reliability.note: The workflow makes module, background, and LIME sensitivity choices explicit and measurable.

performance_context.note: The compact Skill retains bounded-background guidance.

agent_usability.note: The supplied module map is reproducible and its reported analysis choices are clear.

human_usability.note: The opening question and boundary language remain direct.

security.note: No credentials, network access, or destructive behavior.

maintainability.note: The LIME example now reports the overlap used to support its conclusion.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, escape hatches, and hand-offs remain strong.

inputs.label: TreeSHAP module aggregation with a stated module map
inputs.note: Spearman/average-linkage/fcluster construction ran under pandas 3.0.5; A/B share a module and all input columns map exactly once.

inputs.label: TreeSHAP correlated-feature estimand boundary
inputs.note: Depth-1 unused B/C are exactly zero under both modes; depth-2 A/B split differs (B 0.3925 path-dependent vs 0.3511 interventional).

inputs.label: Permutation importance under correlation
inputs.note: Held-out A importance rose from 0.2227 with B present to 0.4888 when B was removed.

inputs.label: Background choice and explicit rank-overlap measurement
inputs.note: Two defensible backgrounds were executed and top-3 overlap was measured (3/3 here); the documentation no longer presumes movement.

inputs.label: LIME seed-sensitivity reporting
inputs.note: The bundled example ran end to end and prints distinct-set count plus mean pairwise top-5 overlap; source checks confirm the measured-language requirements.

key_strengths: All prior P1/P2 findings are resolved at the exact commit, including the central TreeSHAP precision defect.
Both shipped examples execute under the recorded audit environment and the LIME example now emits the stability metric its prose requires.
The module-map recipe is executable on the live pandas 3 environment and declares choices that can change rankings.
